originalTitle: OpenSpec – A lightweight and configurable AI spec framework
content:
OpenSpec is a lightweight and configurable framework for creating and managing software specifications.

With OpenSpec, you capture what you want to build in a spec and keep your team and coding agents aligned as the work evolves. We help you refine the requirements, validate that they describe the right thing, and verify that the implementation matches.

In essence, OpenSpec helps you build the right thing and build it right .

68.0k GitHub stars. A new spec every two seconds .

A new spec is created with OpenSpec every two seconds .

OpenSpec helps create a new spec every two seconds , has earned 68.0k GitHub stars , and is used by more than 265,000 developers a month .

Built in the open. Used in the wild.
